metadata.dcterms:title: RESURGENCE, HABIRO ELEMENTS AND STRANGE IDENTITIES
metadata.dcterms:creator: CREW, SAMUEL
FANTINI, VERONICA
GOSWAMI, ANKUSH
OSBURN, ROBERT
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We prove resurgence properties for the Borel transform of a formal power series associated to elements in the Habiro ring that come from radial limits of partial theta series via strange identities. As an application, we prove a conjecture in quantum topology due to Costin and Garoufalidis for two families of torus knots.
